label: exploratory_two_alternative_targets

donor_prompts.cream_only: put the cream cheese box in the basket
donor_prompts.cream_pick: pick up the cream cheese box
donor_prompts.butter_only: put the butter in the basket

landmark: Same rounded lower-left corner of the camera-facing horizontal gripper palm housing in all nine external-camera frames; missing or ambiguous points cannot be interpolated
review_policy: AI-assisted exploratory review authorized; independent human review remains pending. Prompt target is a hypothesis, never a semantic label.
selection_rule: Rank cream/butter pairs by maximum norm discrepancy across both recipient seeds, then IDs. Review the first eight norm-eligible pairs per state. Require native all-nine-frame semantic/appearance review, visible motion landmarks, motion matching, and pair-level orientation/appearance review. Freeze every state before policy comparisons. No unmatched comparisons.
analysis_unit: initial state, after averaging two recipient action seeds
no_match_behavior: Do not execute unmatched policy comparisons
limitations: Adaptive exploratory follow-up, same three states, one model/task. Both target instructions conflict with original task. Tests short-chunk directional coupling, not task usefulness, benchmark success or isolated target semantics.
rationale: Separate adaptive follow-up to the initial soup/cream search, whose first two states had no norm-eligible pair. Both donors now target objects outside the fixed original recipient instruction; this avoids comparing a near-baseline target with a distant alternative. No claim that either donor is the recipient native policy intent.
